compute contrasts for full models

Source: R/tidyMS_R6_Modelling.R
my_contrast.Rd

compute contrasts for full models

Usage

my_contrast(
  m,
  linfct,
  strategy = NULL,
  coef = coefficients(m),
  Sigma.hat = vcov(m),
  confint = 0.95
)

Arguments

m

linear model generated using lm

linfct

linear function

strategy

optional strategy for df and sigma computation

coef

coefficients vector, default from model

Sigma.hat

variance-covariance matrix, default from model

confint

which confidence interval to determine

Examples


m <-  sim_make_model_lm( "factors")
#> creating sampleName from fileName column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
#> Joining with `by = join_by(protein_Id)`
linfct <- linfct_from_model(m)$linfct_factors
my_glht(m, linfct)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 10
#>   contrast    null.value estimate std.error statistic adj.p.value conf.low
